notes: Cash-basis school district; all funds governmental (School Nutrition is a nonmajor governmental fund here), so business_type is null. Receipts/disbursements use the Total Governmental Funds column (pp3-4); statement of activities (pp1-2) agrees. Statement receipts lines add to 180,756,041 vs printed 180,756,541 (500 contributions line omitted, see report_discrepancies). Debt service 31,147,179 (p4) split into principal 18,595,000 and interest/fees 12,552,179 using the Bond Fund (p17) and Special Building Fund (p19) schedules. Debt proceeds = Sale of bonds 40,000,000; premium 2,880,593 is other_financing. Transfers (502,802 General to Activities) net to zero in the total column, so transfers_in/out are null. Detail: used the fund budget-and-actual schedules (pp9-21), which are more detailed than the combining schedules (pp6-8), so the combining schedules were not entered (no double counting). General Fund detail expenditure items are program lines with no object breakdown (not itemized); category for State/Federal programs lines is a guess (instruction). The combining schedule p6-7 shows a 901,423 transfer to the Depreciation Fund hidden in General Fund lines (reclassification eliminates it from State/Federal programs); recorded as a contra expenditure line plus an other financing line, and matching +901,423 in Depreciation Fund. Bond Fund 65,000,000 budgeted bond sale has no actual. Federal programs header budget 2,553,616 and 4525 Carl Perkins receipt budget 87,230 have no actuals/items so not entered. Balance sheet is the governmental funds cash-basis statement (p5, no liabilities); county treasurer's balances classed as cash and investments. Read pages 1-21 of 21.
